summary.text: Robert Wojtowicz is the Republican candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Democratic Rep. Denise Mentzer.
He is a member of the Chippewa Valley Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Robert Wojtowicz ran for the Chippewa Valley Schools board in the November 2016 general election and lost to three incumbents.
He later joined the Chippewa Valley Board of Education as an at-large member.
In 2024 Wojtowicz won the Republican primary for Michigan House of Representatives District 61 and lost the general election to Mentzer, 50.7% to 49.3%.
In the August 4, 2026 Republican primary he defeated John Grossenbacher with 72.4% of the vote.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Macomb County and named education, lower taxes and affordability, and foreign influence as his key messages.
